Key vocabulary: Hatching — parallel lines building tone.; Negative space — the shapes around objects, drawn to get objects right..
Governing principle: Envelope: blocking the big shape before details.
how_it_works: Working with The Future of Drawing in practice means applying Value studies: limited-tone exercises building modeling skill. The practitioner keeps two reference facts at hand — Hatching: parallel lines building tone.; Negative space: the shapes around objects, drawn to get objects right. — and checks each decision against the governing principles: Envelope: blocking the big shape before details.; Chiaroscuro: light-dark modeling giving volume..
